subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this opt-in durable wake/replay contract in core for the beta release, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104327 merged first?
rationale: The patch has strong implementation and proof signal, but it creates a new core runtime owner, persisted schema, and future message/session delivery contract whose release inclusion and long-term ownership require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor After PR2
options.body: Accept the durable-core direction, land the runtime foundation first, then rebase and revalidate this wake/replay layer on its canonical base.

options.title: Defer The Stack
options.body: Keep the PR open but exclude the durable runtime from the current beta until combined upgrade and end-to-end delivery proof is available.

options.title: Decline Core Direction
options.body: Close the durable stack and keep recovery improvements within existing task, session, and subagent owners instead of adding a new core substrate.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After PR2
recommendation.body: Accept the durable-core direction, land the runtime foundation first, then rebase and revalidate this wake/replay layer on its canonical base.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level product, ownership, and release decision for a new core runtime.
